official_sources.use: December 2024 imaging-option identity and FY2025-FY2034 score
controlling CY2026 drug-administration site-neutral policy, beneficiary savings, 340B non-drug offset, and outpatient quality-measure context
OPPS exclusions, off-campus PBD treatment, rural SCH clinic exception, and coinsurance context

current_law_overlap_findings: CMS finalized PFS-equivalent payment for drug-administration APCs in excepted off-campus PBDs for CY2026, not the selected imaging option.
CMS estimated the drug-administration policy reduces 2026 OPPS spending by $290 million: $220 million for Medicare and $70 million for beneficiaries.
A separate 0.5 percent CY2026 OPPS conversion-factor reduction applies to many non-drug items and services as part of the 340B remedy offset and may overlap the imaging score base.
The December 2024 CBO imaging option has not been formally rescored against those CY2026 policies or the January 2026 CBO baseline.

gate_rows.evidence: CBO publishes the imaging option and annual FY2025-FY2034 effects; the vintage is retained explicitly.
CMS reports lower beneficiary coinsurance from its analogous 2026 drug-administration policy, but no imaging-specific beneficiary amount or distribution is published.
MedPAC supplies general access context; no imaging-location, appointment, relocation, closure, or capacity response is identified for this option.
CMS documents certain OPPS exclusions and a rural SCH clinic exception, but no imaging-option rural, CAH, REH, sole-community, or safety-net distribution is scored.
CMS identifies outpatient quality programs and a voluntary excessive-radiation CT measure, but no diagnostic completion, delay, substitution, or image-quality effect for this option.
Current policy supplies billing mechanics and general site incentives, but no imaging-specific ownership, consolidation, coding, volume, or location response.
CY2026 drug-administration site neutrality and the 340B non-drug offset alter the current-law OPPS context; no formal imaging-option rescore or overlap reconciliation exists.

public_warning: Level A is complete because every evidence gate is now dispositioned against CY2026 current law, not because the candidate passed. The December 2024 CBO score remains unadmitted and requires proposal-specific floor evidence and a formal current-law rescore.
